purpose: FRTB IMA Expected Shortfall pre-validation: MC simulation across liquidity horizons LH1–LH5 (10/20/40/60/120 days), NMRF surcharge estimation, PLA Test (green/amber/red), IMA vs SA floor capital comparison. Educational pre-validator ahead of UK IMA go-live January 2028.
